entries.source: Caught the attention of overpowered greater multi-hued wyrms in Vor Armoury. Perhaps fleeing is in order.
entries.target: 在沃尔的军械库引起了超强的七彩龙精英的注意。也许，离开是最好的主意。

entries.source: Killed the seven overpowered wyrms in the "Room of Death" in Vor Armoury.
entries.target: 在沃尔的军械库的“死亡之屋”杀死7只超强的七彩龙精英。
选择半身人种族并杀死自己。

entries.source: Had the golem kill a boss while its master was already dead.
entries.target: 当傀儡杀死BOSS时，炼金术师已死亡。

entries.source: Killed a boss while already dead.
entries.target: 在已死亡的状态下杀死一个BOSS。

entries.source: Look at me, I'm playing a roguelike!
Linked yourself in the in-game chat.
entries.target: 将自己的数据链接到聊天框。

entries.source: Destroyed the Master in its lair of the Dreadfell.
Found the mysterious staff and told Last Hope about it.
entries.target: 找到神秘法杖并通知最后的希望。
发现了关于法师的真相。

entries.source: Gave the staff of absorption to the apprentice mage and watched the fireworks.
entries.target: 把吸能法杖交给法师学徒并观看烟火。
在埋伏战里杀死乌克鲁克。

entries.source: Activated a portal using the Orb of Many Ways.
entries.target: 用多元水晶球激活传送门。

entries.source: Went to the Far East and took part in the war.
Raced through the fires of the Charred Scar to stop the Sorcerers.
entries.target: 穿过灼烧之痕的火海并成功阻止巫师们。

entries.source: Killed the leaders of the Orc Pride.
Won ToME by preventing the Void portal from opening.
entries.target: 成功阻止虚空传送门，通关ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal using Aeryn as a sacrifice.
entries.target: 以艾琳的牺牲来阻止虚空传送门，通关ToME。
太阳骑士艾琳在最后一战存活。

entries.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal using yourself as a sacrifice.
entries.target: 以自身为祭品关闭虚空传送门，通关ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME by sacrificing yourself to forcefully spread the Way to every other sentient being on Eyal.
entries.target: 牺牲自己，将维网强行传播给埃亚尔上每一个其他有知觉的生命，通关ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal and letting yourself be killed by Aeryn to prevent the Way to enslave every sentient being on Eyal.
entries.target: 关闭虚空传送门并让自己被艾琳杀死，以防止维网奴役埃亚尔上每一个有知觉的生命，通关ToME。

entries.source: This is how the world ends: swallowed in fire, but not in darkness.
entries.target: 这就是世界终结的方式：并非被黑暗，而是被火焰吞噬。

entries.source: "Won" ToME by sacrificing yourself for your patron Distant Sun, opening a portal for it to burn and consume the world.
entries.target: 牺牲自己，为你的主上遥远的太阳打开传送门，任其焚烧并吞噬整个世界，以此"通关"ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME by closing the Void portal and letting yourself be killed by Aeryn to prevent your mad patron sun from burning the world in a searing flash.
entries.target: 关闭虚空传送门并让自己被艾琳杀死，以阻止你那疯狂的太阳主上在一道灼目的闪光中焚毁世界，通关ToME。

entries.source: Won ToME thanks to a Sher'tul stopping you at the last moment from opening a portal to your mad patron sun.
entries.target: 多亏一名夏·图尔人在最后一刻阻止你开启通往你那疯狂的太阳主上的传送门，你才得以通关ToME。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers without closing any invocation portals.
entries.target: 在不关闭传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed one invocation portal.
entries.target: 与两名巫师交战并关闭了1扇召唤传送门。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed two invocation portals.
entries.target: 与两名巫师交战并关闭了2扇召唤传送门。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed three invocation portals.
entries.target: 在关闭3扇召唤传送门的情况下，与两名巫师交战。

entries.source: Fought the two Sorcerers and closed four invocation portals.
entries.target: 在关闭4扇传送门的情况下，杀死2名巫师。

entries.source: Never Look Back And There Again
Win the game without ever setting foot on Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 在从未踏足马基·埃亚尔的情况下通关游戏。

entries.source: Won the game without ever taking off her bikini.
entries.target: 在没有脱下比基尼的情况下获得胜利。
